title: In Re Korean Northwest Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC approved the motion to accept Korean Northwest Presbytery's amended and corrected responses to exceptions; Neikirk dissented, Dowling abstained, and Bankson, Robertson, and Carrell were absent. No merits ruling on the exceptions appears.
first_summary: The SJC accepted Korean Northwest Presbytery's amended and corrected responses to exceptions, with one dissent and one abstention.
summary: The SJC approved a motion to accept Korean Northwest Presbytery's amended and corrected responses to exceptions on a roll-call vote; Neikirk dissented and Dowling abstained, with three members absent. The amended responses therefore stand accepted. The source supplies no underlying exception content or reasons, so the action is a procedural acceptance rather than a merits ruling.
